verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance ships multiple built-in, task-delegatable AI agents embedded in the product — SRE Agent (troubleshoots/fixes incidents, configurable Skills, GitHub/Sentry connectors), Scribe Agent (joins calls, transcribes, generates PIRs), Shift Agent (handles schedule conflicts autonomously), and Insights Agent (conversational analytics) — going beyond a simple chatbot to actual task delegation within the product UI/workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on user reports validating these agents in practice (all evidence is vendor documentation) and no community commentary specifically confirming real-world delegation experience.
